children: , a platform that will use transaction-based data to help brands recognize emerging consumer needs, identify engagement opportunities, and measure campaigns' effectiveness, the company said on Wednesday.

The bank serves more than 70M U.S. customers and sees 6.5B annual transactions across more than 700 spending categories. The platform combines consumer insights, paid media solutions, and closed-loop measurement to help brands connect with consumers more effectively, Citi said.

agreement to acquire Kard, a commerce media and rewards platform. The pending addition of Kard will further bolster Citi Commerce Media's capabilities and expand opportunities for brands to strengthen customer engagement, loyalty, and growth, the company said.

"By leveraging Citi’s scale, transaction insights, and measurement capabilities, we can help our partners better anticipate consumer needs, reach the right audience at the right moment, and drive strong business outcomes while delivering more relevant offers and ads for customers," said Abhinav Anand, Citi’s head of Value Cards, Lending, and Commerce.
Initial campaigns across retail, payments, technology, and beauty and wellness categories showed strong performance, including up to 5x incremental return on ad spend for an online retailer.
